title: El desayuno
blurbEn: Breakfast at Ana's house, and your first good look at how regular verbs change their endings depending on who is doing the action.
body:
Por la mañana desayuno en la cocina. Bebo café con leche y como pan.

Mi padre bebe té. Mi madre come fruta.

Nosotros hablamos mucho.

Me gusta mucho la mañana.
translationEn:
In the morning I have breakfast in the kitchen. I drink coffee with milk and eat bread.

My father drinks tea. My mother eats fruit.

We talk a lot.

I like the morning very much.

bebo.note: 'beber' is an -er verb: beb-o for I, beb-e for he or she.
